name: chat.message.received
description: Message received. A creator sent a message in a direct thread or a group. `isFirstMessage` marks the first message of a conversation.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`). Direct threads only.

campaignId.description: Only events about this campaign (`orgcamp_…`). Campaign groups only.

message.content: Hi! I just posted the second video.

name: chat.message.sent
description: Message sent. Your side sent a message: from the dashboard, the API, the Copilot, a broadcast, an application reply or a join note. `source` says which surface; skip events carrying your own `apiKeyId` to avoid loops.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`). Direct threads only.

campaignId.description: Only events about this campaign (`orgcamp_…`). Campaign groups only.

message.content: Great, thanks! Payout for this week goes out on Monday.

name: chat.system_message.created
description: Status message posted. viral.app posted a status message into a thread (an application decision, an assignment, a payout, a group created). `message.metadata.systemEvent.type` (or `systemStatus.status` for application decisions) names what happened.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`). Direct threads only.

campaignId.description: Only events about this campaign (`orgcamp_…`). Campaign groups only.

name: chat.message.updated
description: Message edited. A message was edited. `message` is the edited version.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`). Direct threads only.

campaignId.description: Only events about this campaign (`orgcamp_…`). Campaign groups only.

message.content: Hi! I just posted the second video.

name: chat.message.deleted
description: Message deleted. A message was deleted. Its content is gone; the id stays as a tombstone.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`). Direct threads only.

campaignId.description: Only events about this campaign (`orgcamp_…`). Campaign groups only.

name: chat.reaction.added
description: Reaction added. Someone reacted to a message with an emoji. `reaction.side` says whether your team (`org`) or the creator reacted.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`). Direct threads only.

campaignId.description: Only events about this campaign (`orgcamp_…`). Campaign groups only.

name: chat.reaction.removed
description: Reaction removed. A reaction to a message was taken back by whoever added it.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`). Direct threads only.

campaignId.description: Only events about this campaign (`orgcamp_…`). Campaign groups only.

name: chat.thread.updated
description: Group updated. A group was renamed, or a manual group's members changed. `changes` lists what changed; `addedCreatorUserIds` and `removedCreatorUserIds` name member changes.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`). Direct threads only.

campaignId.description: Only events about this campaign (`orgcamp_…`). Campaign groups only.

name: chat.thread.deleted
description: Thread deleted. A conversation and its messages were deleted: a group deleted by your team, a campaign group with its campaign, or the threads of a creator who was deleted or deleted their account.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`). Direct threads only.

campaignId.description: Only events about this campaign (`orgcamp_…`). Campaign groups only.

name: creator.created
description: Creator added. A creator was added to your roster: by hand, by accepting an application, by approving a join request, or through an invitation link. `via` and the ids say which.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

name: creator.updated
description: Creator updated. Your team changed a creator's profile, notes, tags or tracked accounts. `changedFields` lists which; the creator's own edits are not reported.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

name: creator.invited
description: Creator invited. A platform invitation was emailed to a creator, or re-sent (`resent`). Sent once the email went out.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

name: creator.invitation_declined
description: Invitation declined. A creator declined your platform invitation.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

name: creator.invitation_revoked
description: Invitation revoked. Your team revoked a creator's pending platform invitation.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

name: creator.joined
description: Creator joined. A creator became a member of your organization on viral.app: they accepted an invitation, or joined through an accepted application, an approved join request or an invitation link.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

name: creator.archived
description: Creator archived. A creator was archived. Assignments and payout windows the archive resolved come as their own events.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

name: creator.unarchived
description: Creator unarchived. An archived creator was restored to your active roster.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

name: creator.deleted
description: Creator deleted. A creator was removed from your roster for good: deleted by your team, or the creator deleted their viral.app account. `creator` is the last state before the delete.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

name: creator.join_request.created
description: Join request received. A creator asked to join through your organization's invitation link.

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

joinRequest.message: Hi! I'd love to join your creator program.

name: creator.join_request.approved
description: Join request approved. A join request was approved and the creator was onboarded. `creator` is the roster entry it created or restored.

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

joinRequest.message: Hi! I'd love to join your creator program.

name: creator.join_request.rejected
description: Join request rejected. Your team rejected a join request.

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

joinRequest.message: Hi! I'd love to join your creator program.

name: creator.join_request.canceled
description: Join request canceled. A pending join request was canceled after 30 days without a decision.

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

joinRequest.message: Hi! I'd love to join your creator program.

name: campaign.created
description: Campaign created. A campaign was created.

name: campaign.updated
description: Campaign updated. A campaign's name, description, video target, payout terms or end date changed. `changeSource` is `end` when an end date was set; new terms apply to every unpaid window at once.

name: campaign.reactivated
description: Campaign reactivated. A campaign's end date was cleared, so it runs on.

name: campaign.started
description: Campaign started. A campaign reached its start date. Reported right away for a campaign that starts today or earlier, otherwise shortly after 00:00 UTC on the day.

name: campaign.ended
description: Campaign ended. A campaign's last day passed. A campaign ending today is still running; this fires shortly after 00:00 UTC the next day.

name: campaign.deleted
description: Campaign deleted. A campaign was deleted, with the assignments it still had (each reported as `assignment.canceled`). `campaign` is its last state.

name: brief.published
description: Brief published. A brief reached its creators: created or updated with a notification to them (`created`, `updated`), or newly reaching creators without a new version (`assigned`: linked to a campaign, sent to creators directly, or shared with everyone at the organization). Saves without a notification that reach nobody new are not reported.

campaignId.description: Only events about this campaign (`orgcamp_…`). Briefs linked to it.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`). Briefs sent to them directly.

name: brief.read
description: Brief read. A creator read a brief version for the first time.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`).

name: assignment.created
description: Creator assigned. A creator was assigned to a campaign, starting now, on a past date, or in the future (including the next campaign after a switch).

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: assignment.started
description: Assignment started. An assignment became active. Reported right away when it starts today or earlier, otherwise shortly after 00:00 UTC on its first day.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: assignment.updated
description: Assignment updated. An assignment's dates changed: an end was scheduled, moved or cleared. `previous` holds the dates before the change.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: assignment.canceled
description: Assignment removed. An assignment was removed entirely: deleted by your team (`revoked`), unassigned before it started (`cleared`), or removed when its campaign ended or was deleted, the creator was archived, or the plan lapsed. `assignment` is its last state; periods it covered are no longer due.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: assignment.ended
description: Assignment ended. An assignment's last day passed. Reported right away for an end today or in the past (an unassign, a settlement that ends it today), otherwise shortly after 00:00 UTC the day after (`scheduled`).

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: assignment.period_started
description: Billing period started. A new billing period of an assignment began. Periods turn at 00:00 UTC; reported shortly after.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: assignment.period_ended
description: Billing period ended. A billing period of an assignment completed. `nextPeriod` is the one that follows (null after the last), `payoutState` where its payout stands: `due` (a `payout.due` follows when it has an amount), `paid` or `canceled` already.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: payout.due
description: Payout due. A billing window became due, as the Due tab shows it (windows with nothing to pay are left out). Reported in the morning pass (~06:40 UTC). A window that becomes due again (after a withdrawal or a reinstatement) comes with a higher `generation`. Windows already due when you subscribed are not reported; `GET /payouts/due` lists them.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: payout.due_cleared
description: Payout no longer due. A window reported as due left the Due tab: paid, covered by partial payments, written off, closed at zero, canceled, or retracted (its assignment ended before it, or the terms now pay nothing).

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: payout.initiated
description: Payout initiated. A payout was issued: accepted by the payout provider, or marked as paid outside it. `kind` separates window payouts, partial payments, manual and video payouts and reissues.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: payout.status_changed
description: Payout status changed. The payout provider moved a payout: created, approved, requested (the creator claims it), completed, deleted or expired.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: payout.paid
description: Payout paid. Money reached the creator: the provider completed the payout, or it was marked as paid outside the platform.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: payout.withdrawn
description: Payout withdrawn. Your team withdrew a payout the creator had not claimed yet. Its window becomes due again.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: payout.canceled
description: Window payout canceled. A billing window's payout was canceled (by your team, or when the creator was archived), so the window will not be paid.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: payout.reinstated
description: Window payout reinstated. A canceled window's payout was reinstated; the window can be paid again.

creatorId.description: Only events about this creator (their roster id, `orgcre_…`).

name: payout_hold.changed
description: Payout hold changed. Your organization's payout hold changed as creator payouts went overdue or were settled: `watch` (an early warning), `soft`, `hard`, or lifted (`stage: null`). During a hard hold the API refuses most writes.

name: job.created
description: Job created. A job posting was created (as a draft, or published right away) or duplicated.

jobId.description: Only events about this job posting (`orgjob_…`).

name: job.updated
description: Job updated. A published or paused job posting was edited, its description, requirements and videos included. Drafts are not reported while they are being written, nor a save that changes nothing.

jobId.description: Only events about this job posting (`orgjob_…`).

name: job.status_changed
description: Job status changed. A job was published, paused or resumed. `job.pausedReason` is `subscription_lapsed` when viral.app paused it after the plan lapsed.

jobId.description: Only events about this job posting (`orgjob_…`).

name: job.deleted
description: Job deleted. A job posting was deleted. `job` is its last state.

jobId.description: Only events about this job posting (`orgjob_…`).

name: application.created
description: Application created. A creator applied to a job (`source: applied`), or your team asked a matched creator to apply (`source: invited`).

jobId.description: Only events about this job posting (`orgjob_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`). The applicant.

name: application.submitted
description: Application submitted. A creator's application arrived and waits on your team: a direct application, or an answered invitation. The one event to count applications by.

jobId.description: Only events about this job posting (`orgjob_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`). The applicant.

name: application.status_changed
description: Application status changed. An application moved: in review, accepted, rejected, withdrawn, answered, declined (`not_interested`), withdrawn by your team (`retracted`) or closed after 14 days without a decision (`auto_closed`).

jobId.description: Only events about this job posting (`orgjob_…`).

creatorUserId.description: Only events about this creator's user (`user_…`). The applicant.

status.description: Only applications that moved to this status.

name: video.published
description: Video posted. A tracked account posted a new video, seen in the next sync. Only videos published after your organization started tracking the account are reported, never older ones a first sync or a larger video limit brings in. Opt-in: endpoints subscribed to all events (`*`) do not receive it; subscribe to it by name.

accountId.description: Only events about this tracked account (`orgacc_…`).

name: video.views_milestone
description: Video views milestone. A tracked video passed a view milestone (10,000, 50,000, 100,000, 250,000, 500,000, 1,000,000, 5,000,000, 10,000,000), as the synced data shows it. One event per milestone; a video that jumps past several between syncs reports each. Videos first seen above a milestone (a newly tracked account's history) never report it. Opt-in: endpoints subscribed to all events (`*`) do not receive it; subscribe to it by name.

accountId.description: Only events about this tracked account (`orgacc_…`).

minMilestone.description: Only milestones at least this many views (e.g. 100000).

name: account.followers_milestone
description: Followers milestone. A tracked account passed a follower milestone (1,000, 10,000, 50,000, 100,000, 500,000, 1,000,000, 5,000,000, 10,000,000), as the synced data shows it. One event per milestone. Accounts first seen above a milestone never report it. Opt-in: endpoints subscribed to all events (`*`) do not receive it; subscribe to it by name.

accountId.description: Only events about this tracked account (`orgacc_…`).

minMilestone.description: Only milestones at least this many followers (e.g. 10000).
